title: Pope Leo XIV Leaves Hospital Following Successful Lung Surgery
subtitle: The 71-year-old leader is recovering well and plans to resume public duties this Sunday.

summary.en: Pope Leo XIV has been discharged from Gemelli Hospital in Rome after a successful operation to remove a cancerous growth from his lung. The 71-year-old leader walked out of the hospital unaided just four days after the procedure. Doctors report that his recovery is progressing steadily and he is expected to return to public life this weekend. The Vatican confirmed that the Pope has already resumed some duties, including a diplomatic call to Russia. Plans for his upcoming trip to Latin America remain in place as his medical team expresses optimism about his health.
summary.zh: 教宗良十四世在成功切除肺部腫瘤手術後，已從羅馬的傑梅利醫院出院。這位七十一歲的領袖在術後僅四天便能自行走出醫院。醫師報告指出，他的復原進度穩定，預計本週末將重返公眾生活。梵蒂岡證實教宗已恢復部分職務，包括與俄羅斯進行外交通話。由於醫療團隊對他的健康狀況表示樂觀，他前往拉丁美洲的預定行程目前維持不變。

paragraphs.en: Pope Leo XIV has officially left Gemelli Hospital in Rome, just four days after undergoing surgery to remove a cancerous growth from his lung. The 71-year-old leader, who became the first US-born head of the Roman Catholic Church last year, was seen walking to his car without any help on Saturday afternoon. His departure comes as a positive sign for Catholics around the world, as many had feared a much longer recovery period.
paragraphs.zh: 教宗良十四世（Pope Leo XIV）已正式離開位於羅馬的傑梅利醫院（Gemelli Hospital），距離他接受肺部腫瘤切除手術僅過了四天。這位七十一歲的領袖去年成為首位美國出生的羅馬天主教會元首，週六下午被目擊在無人攙扶的情況下自行走向座車。他的出院對全球天主教徒而言是個正面訊號，因為許多人原先擔心他需要更長的恢復期。

paragraphs.en: The surgery took place on Tuesday and lasted 90 minutes. During the procedure, surgeons removed the lower part of the Pope’s right lung to extract a tumor identified as adenocarcinoma, a common type of lung cancer. According to The Guardian, his doctors, Luigi Carbone and Stefano Margaritora, stated that the Pope was “fit for discharge” after reviewing his latest blood tests and chest X-rays. While the medical team is still waiting for final test results to see if the cancer has spread, they noted that his recovery is progressing normally.
paragraphs.zh: 手術於週二進行，歷時九十分鐘。過程中，外科醫師切除了教宗右肺下葉，以取出被診斷為腺癌的腫瘤，這是一種常見的肺癌類型。根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，他的主治醫師路易吉·卡波內（Luigi Carbone）與史蒂法諾·馬加里托拉（Stefano Margaritora）在審視過最新的血液檢查與胸部Ｘ光片後，表示教宗「狀況良好，可以出院」。儘管醫療團隊仍在等待最終檢驗結果以確認癌症是否擴散，但他們指出教宗的復原進度正常。

paragraphs.en: The Vatican announced that the Pope will return to his public duties this Sunday. He is scheduled to lead the traditional Angelus prayer and offer a blessing to the crowd gathered in St Peter’s Square. This is a significant change from his earlier schedule, which had been cleared of all public events until October 20. The Pope’s quick return to public life is seen as a relief for many, especially since he surprised the world by announcing his own surgery during his prayer last week.
paragraphs.zh: 梵蒂岡宣布，教宗將於本週日恢復公開職務。他預計將主持傳統的三鐘經祈禱，並為聚集在聖伯多祿廣場（St Peter’s Square）的群眾降福。這與他先前排定直到十月二十日前暫停所有公開活動的行程相比，有顯著的變動。教宗能如此迅速地重返公眾生活，對許多人來說是一大寬慰，特別是他上週在祈禱時親自宣布手術消息，令全球感到震驚。

paragraphs.en: Even while in the hospital, the Pope remained active. On Friday, he was photographed celebrating Mass and giving communion to hospital staff in his room. Furthermore, he held a diplomatic phone call with Russian President Vladimir Putin. According to BBC News, this was the first time the two leaders had spoken since June 2025. During the conversation, the Pope urged the Russian president to seek peace and dialogue. He specifically called for a humanitarian ceasefire — an agreement to stop fighting for a short time — in the Ukrainian city of Oleshky. The city is currently under Russian control and faces constant shelling, leaving many residents without enough food or medicine.
paragraphs.zh: 即便身在醫院，教宗仍保持活躍。週五，他被拍到在病房內舉行彌撒並為醫院員工施行聖餐禮。此外，他還與俄羅斯總統普丁（Vladimir Putin）進行了外交通話。根據英國廣播公司新聞（BBC News）報導，這是兩位領袖自二〇二五年六月以來的首次對話。在談話中，教宗敦促俄羅斯總統尋求和平與對話。他特別呼籲在烏克蘭的奧列什基（Oleshky）市實行人道停火，即暫時停止戰鬥的協議。該市目前處於俄羅斯控制之下，且面臨持續砲擊，導致許多居民缺乏足夠的糧食與藥物。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, there is growing interest in whether the Pope will be able to keep his travel plans for November. He is scheduled to visit Latin America, including a trip to Peru, where he spent many years working as a missionary. Some had worried that the surgery would force him to cancel these plans. However, his surgeon, Dr. Stefano Margaritora, told Vatican media that there are no medical reasons to prevent the trip. He expects the Pope to recover fully in about ten days and believes that air travel in three weeks should be safe.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，外界對於教宗是否能維持十一月的出訪計畫日益關注。他預計將訪問拉丁美洲，包括前往他曾擔任傳教士多年的秘魯。有些人曾擔心手術會迫使他取消這些行程。然而，他的外科醫師馬加里托拉向梵蒂岡媒體表示，沒有任何醫療理由需要阻止這趟旅程。他預期教宗將在十天內完全康復，並認為三週後的航空旅行應該是安全的。

paragraphs.en: The Gemelli Hospital, located in the north-west of Rome, is well-known for its history of treating popes. It is equipped with a high-security papal suite, which was created after many visits by Pope John Paul II. Before this diagnosis, the Pope was generally considered to be in good health. He is known to enjoy sports, particularly tennis, and often spends time at the papal retreat in Castel Gandolfo near Rome.
paragraphs.zh: 位於羅馬西北部的傑梅利醫院，以其治療歷任教宗的歷史而聞名。院內設有高規格的教宗專用套房，這是為了因應教宗若望保祿二世（Pope John Paul II）多次造訪而設立的。在這次診斷之前，教宗的健康狀況普遍被認為良好。他熱愛運動，特別是網球，並經常前往羅馬附近的教宗避暑別墅岡道爾夫堡（Castel Gandolfo）休憩。

paragraphs.en: While the Pope’s rapid recovery is encouraging, his medical team continues to monitor him closely. The results of further tests will determine if he needs additional treatment to ensure the cancer does not return. For now, the Vatican remains focused on his return to his apartment window in St Peter’s Square this Sunday. The Pope’s ability to walk out of the hospital on his own has been widely shared as a symbol of his strength as he prepares to resume his responsibilities as the leader of the Church.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然教宗的快速康復令人振奮，但醫療團隊仍持續密切監控他的狀況。後續檢查結果將決定他是否需要額外的治療，以確保癌症不會復發。目前，梵蒂岡的焦點仍放在他本週日回到聖伯多祿廣場公寓窗前露面。教宗能獨自走出醫院，已被廣泛視為他準備重拾教會領袖職責時，展現強健體魄的象徵。

keyTerms.definitionEn: Healthy, strong, and in good physical condition.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（適合/安裝），這裡形容身體狀況良好。文中：According to The Guardian, his doctors, Luigi Carbone and Stefano Margaritora, stated that the Pope was “fit for discharge” after reviewing his latest blood tests and chest X-rays.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A quiet or secluded place where one can go to rest or pray.

quiz.question: What specific action did the Pope take during his hospital stay that involved international diplomacy?

options.A: He held a press conference to discuss his surgery with the media.
options.B: He spoke with President Putin to advocate for a temporary halt to military actions in Oleshky.
options.C: He sent a formal letter to the leaders of Ukraine requesting medical aid.
options.D: He met with hospital staff to organize a peace mission for the city of Oleshky.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第四段，教宗在住院期間與俄羅斯總統普丁進行了外交通話，並明確呼籲在烏克蘭城市奧列什基（Oleshky）實行「人道主義停火」。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章未提及教宗召開記者會；選項 C 錯誤，文中提到的是與普丁通話而非寫信給烏克蘭領導人；選項 D 錯誤，教宗是與普丁談話，而非與醫院員工策劃和平任務。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the medical team's outlook regarding the Pope's upcoming travel plans?

options.A: They are uncertain if he will be strong enough to travel by November.
options.B: They believe the surgery will likely cause him to cancel his missionary trip to Peru.
options.C: They are confident that his recovery will be sufficient for him to fly in three weeks.
options.D: They have advised him to avoid air travel until he has fully recovered in ten days.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第五段，外科醫生 Dr. Stefano Margaritora 表示沒有醫療理由阻止教宗前往秘魯，並預期他將在十天內完全康復，且認為三週後的航空旅行是安全的。選項 A 不正確，因為醫生對此持正面態度；選項 B 與文中醫生的說法相反；選項 D 雖然提到十天康復期，但醫生明確表示三週後搭飛機是安全的，並非建議避免搭機。

quiz.question: In the phrase 'his doctors... stated that the Pope was “fit for discharge”', what does 'fit' mean in this context?

options.B: Suitable or ready for a specific purpose.
options.C: Matching the size of something else.
options.D: In a state of extreme anger.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在此語境下，「fit for discharge」意指「適合出院」或「已達到出院的標準」。選項 A 雖然 fit 常指健康或強壯，但在此處強調的是「符合出院資格」；選項 C 是指形狀或大小吻合；選項 D 與憤怒無關。此處的 fit 是形容詞，表示「有資格的」或「準備好的」。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of this article?

options.A: The history and medical capabilities of Gemelli Hospital in Rome.
options.B: The complex diplomatic challenges currently facing the Roman Catholic Church.
options.C: The Pope's recent surgery and his unexpectedly quick return to normal duties.
options.D: The Pope's long-standing passion for missionary work in Latin America.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。整篇文章的核心內容圍繞在教宗最近的肺部手術、他康復的進度，以及他展現出的強健體力與即將恢復公開職務的決心。選項 A 僅是背景資訊；選項 B 僅提及一段外交通話，非文章主旨；選項 D 僅在第五段提到，屬於細節而非主旨。
